label: EV-02
command_argv:
set -e
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import ast,json,hashlib
root=Path(".")
files=[
 "src/agentic_payment_experiment/models.py",
 "src/agentic_payment_experiment/webshop_runtime_gate.py",
 "src/agentic_payment_experiment/payment_execution.py",
 "src/agentic_payment_experiment/webshop_payment_sidecar.py",
 "src/agentic_payment_experiment/trusted_execution/context_policy.py",
 "src/agentic_payment_experiment/trusted_execution/fact_lineage.py",
 "src/agentic_payment_experiment/trusted_execution/replay.py",
 "src/agentic_payment_experiment/trusted_execution/governed_action.py",
 "src/agentic_payment_experiment/payment_status_conflict.py",
 "src/agentic_payment_experiment/attack_overlays.py",
]
classes={}
enums={}
for rel in files:
    src=(root/rel).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    tree=ast.parse(src)
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node,ast.ClassDef):
            bases=[ast.unparse(x) for x in node.bases]
            fields=[]
            values=[]
            for item in node.body:
                if isinstance(item,ast.AnnAssign) and isinstance(item.target,ast.Name):
                    fields.append({"name":item.target.id,"type":ast.unparse(item.annotation),"default":ast.unparse(item.value) if item.value else None})
                elif isinstance(item,ast.Assign):
                    for target in item.targets:
                        if isinstance(target,ast.Name):
                            try: val=ast.literal_eval(item.value)
                            except Exception: val=ast.unparse(item.value)
                            values.append({"name":target.id,"value":val})
            if fields:
                classes[node.name]={"file":rel,"line":node.lineno,"fields":fields,"bases":bases}
            if any("Enum" in b for b in bases):
                enums[node.name]={"file":rel,"line":node.lineno,"values":values}
fixture=json.loads((root/"samples/evaluation/project_impact_t10_preflight_target_v1.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
after=json.loads((root/"docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_CAPABILITY_REVALIDATION_V1/evidence/fresh_after.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
actual_by_id={x["task_id"]:x["actual"] for x in after["task_results"]}
tasks=[]
for task in fixture["tasks"]:
    tid=task["task_id"]; actual=actual_by_id[tid]
    tasks.append({
      "task_id":tid,
      "scenario":task["scenario"],
      "title":task["title"],
      "expected_decision":task["expected_decision"],
      "expected_callback_count":task["expected_callback_count"],
      "required_facts":task["required_facts"],
      "required_evidence_stages":task["required_evidence_stages"],
      "expected_product_observed_trace_events":task["expected_product_observed_trace_events"],
      "actual_decision":actual["actual_decision"],
      "actual_callback_count":actual["actual_callback_count"],
      "actual_product_trace_status":actual["product_observed_trace_status"],
      "actual_product_trace_source":actual["product_observed_trace_source"],
      "actual_evidence_stages":actual["evidence_stages"],
      "actual_required_facts_observed":actual["required_facts_observed"],
      "actual_final_environment_state":actual["actual_final_environment_state"],
    })
runner=(root/"scripts/validation/run_project_impact_baseline.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
product_boundary={
 "requires_attribute":"authoritative_trace_events" in runner,
 "requires_exact_tuple":"type(events) is not tuple" in runner,
 "requires_exact_replay_event":"type(event) is not ReplayEvent" in runner,
 "runtime_gate_not_product_trace":"RuntimeGateRecord and evaluator-created ReplayEvent values are not treated" in runner,
 "synth_provenance":"runner_constructed_from_fixed_facts" in runner,
}
payload={
 "schema":"product-authoritative-trace-audit-inventory/v1",
 "files":files,
 "class_count":len(classes),
 "classes":classes,
 "enums":enums,
 "product_trace_boundary":product_boundary,
 "task_count":len(tasks),
 "tasks":tasks,
}
out=root/"docs/05_任务交接/P9_PRODUCT_AUTHORITATIVE_TRACE_MINIMUM_CONTRACT_V1/evidence/audit_inventory.json"
out.write_text(json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print("AUDIT_SHA256="+hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print("CLASS_COUNT="+str(len(classes)))
for name in [
 "IntentMandate","Order","TransactionRequest","PaymentExecutionRecord","LifecycleResult","PaymentRecoveryResult",
 "GovernedPaymentAction","RuntimeGateRecord","ReplayEvent","ReplayResult","WebShopBuyNowGateOutcome",
 "PaymentExecutionGateOutcome","WebShopPaymentFulfilmentOutcome","ContextPolicyFact","FactLineageResult","PaymentStatusConflictFact"]:
    print(name+"="+json.dumps(classes.get(name),ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True))
print("ENUM_ReplayEventType="+json.dumps(enums.get("ReplayEventType"),ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True))
print("PRODUCT_BOUNDARY="+json.dumps(product_boundary,sort_keys=True))
for task in tasks:
    print("TASK="+json.dumps(task,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True))
PY
